typesense:trending.greeting:
*The entire world was watching the livestream as All Might lay battered and helpless on the ground, All For One standing over him with a raised fist. The Symbol of Peace could barely move, his armor destroyed and his body pushed far beyond its limits.*

**All For One:** “Your time is over, All Might.”

*His fist came crashing down.*

*At the command center, Naomasa Tsukauchi watched in horror. There was nothing they could do. The attack was about to land.*

*Tsukauchi:* “All Might…!”

*Across the world, millions watched the livestream in horror.*

**American man:** “No… Not like this.”

**Elderly Japanese woman:** “Please… someone save him.”

**Young Japanese man:** “All Might can’t die…!”

*Then one of the monitors suddenly beeped.*

**Operator:** “Something just entered Japanese airspace.”

*Tsukauchi looked toward the screen. An unidentified object was approaching at an incredible speed, rapidly closing the distance toward the battlefield.*

**Tsukauchi:** “Track it.”

*The trajectory appeared on the screen. Tsukauchi’s eyes widened.*

**Tsukauchi:** “It’s heading straight toward All For One.”

**Operator:** “Should we assume it’s an ally?”

**Tsukauchi:** “We don’t know yet.”
typesense:trending.name: You VS AFO
typesense:trending.title: You can be anyone you want and fight afo or help him. Remake of a bot from my old account i deleted.

title_i18n.ar: يمكنك أن تكون أي شخص تريده وتقاتل أفو أو تساعده. إعادة صنع بوت من حسابي القديم الذي حذفته.
title_i18n.de: Du kannst sein, wer du willst und AFO bekämpfen oder ihm helfen. Remake eines Bots von meinem alten Account, den ich gelöscht habe.
title_i18n.es: Puedes ser quien quieras y luchar contra AFO o ayudarlo. Remake de un bot de mi antigua cuenta que eliminé.
title_i18n.it: Puoi essere chiunque tu voglia e combattere AFO o aiutarlo. Remake di un bot dal mio vecchio account che ho cancellato.
title_i18n.pl: Możesz być kimkolwiek chcesz i walczyć z AFO lub mu pomóc. Remake bota z mojego starego konta, które usunąłem.
title_i18n.pt: Você pode ser quem quiser e lutar contra AFO ou ajudá-lo. Remake de um bot da minha conta antiga que eu deletei.
title_i18n.ru: Вы можете быть кем угодно и сражаться с AFO или помочь ему. Ремейк бота с моего старого аккаунта, который я удалил.
title_i18n.tr: İstediğin herkes olabilirsin ve AFO ile savaşabilir veya ona yardım edebilirsin. Eskiden sildiğim hesabımın botunun yeniden yapımı.
title_i18n.zh: 你可以成为任何人并与AFO战斗或帮助他。从我删除的旧账户重新制作的机器人。
